data.narrative:
Flamefront Propulsion is a pre-seed stage propulsion technology company in the Defense & Security sector, founded by Matt Garcia, former founding engineer and head of propulsion at Mach Industries and MIT aeronautics trained. The valuation universe spans 24 same-sector peers: 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, Saronic, and Quantum-Systems.

The peer-median method was not applicable to this analysis. The Defense & Security sector contains sufficient public and private comparables, but the narrow filters required for methodological rigor—same-stage capitalization, adjacent-stage proximity, and similar valuation tier—yielded fewer than three datapoints. Applying all-sector median pricing would introduce material bias given the heterogeneity of defense technology business models and maturity stages. No triangulation result was generated due to this methodological constraint.

The analysis cannot produce a valuation range at this time. A robust conclusion requires either: expansion of the comparable universe to include adjacent aerospace and propulsion verticals outside pure Defense & Security; stage-appropriate private market transactions in propulsion technology; or sufficient public company data normalized for pre-revenue stage dynamics. The primary uncertainty is the absence of near-peer transaction data at the pre-seed stage in this specific subsector.
